'''Michael Rapoport''' (born 2 October 1948)<ref name="hcm.uni-bonn.de">{{cite web | title=HCM: Prof. Dr. Michael Rapoport | website=hcm.uni-bonn.de | url=http://www.hcm.uni-bonn.de/people/profile/michael-rapoport/ | access-date=18 December 2021}}</ref> is an Austrian mathematician.

==Career==
Rapoport received his PhD from [[Paris-Sud 11 University]] in 1976, under the supervision of [[Pierre Deligne]].<ref name=":0">{{MathGenealogy|id=28706}}</ref> He  held a chair for [[arithmetic algebraic geometry]] at the [[University of Bonn]],<ref name="Mathematisches Institut der Universität Bonn 2019">{{cite web | title=Prof. Dr. Michael Rapoport (i.R.) | website=Mathematisches Institut der Universität Bonn | date=19 October 2019 | url=http://www.math.uni-bonn.de/ag/alggeom/rapoport | language=de | access-date=18 December 2021}}</ref> as well as a visiting appointment at the University of Maryland. In 1992, he was awarded the [[Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize]],<ref>[https://www.dfg.de/download/pdf/gefoerderte_projekte/preistraeger/gwl-preis/leibniz_preistraeger_86_22.pdf List of Leibniz Prize winners from 1986 to 2022], [[Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft|DFG]]</ref> in 1999 he won the [[Gay-Lussac Humboldt Prize]],<ref name="idw - Informationsdienst Wissenschaft e.V. 2000">{{cite web | title=Gay-Lussac/Humboldt-Preis für Professor Rapoport | website=idw – Informationsdienst Wissenschaft e.V. | date=17 July 2000 | url=https://nachrichten.idw-online.de/2000/07/17/gay-lussac-humboldt-preis-fuer-professor-rapoport/ | language=de | access-date=18 December 2021}}</ref> and he is the recipient of the 2011 [[Heinz Hopf Prize]].<ref name="ETH Zurich 2021">{{cite web | title=Laureates | website=ETH Zurich | date=22 September 2021 | url=https://math.ethz.ch/news-and-events/events/lecture-series/heinz-hopf-prize-and-lectures/laureates.html | access-date=18 December 2021}}</ref> In 1994, he was an Invited Speaker (with talk ''Non-Archimedean period domains'') at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians|ICM]] in Zürich.

Rapoport's students include [[Maria Heep-Altiner]], Werner Baer, [[Peter Scholze]], [[Eva Viehmann]].<ref name=":0" />

==Personal life==
Michael Rapoport is the son of pediatrician [[Ingeborg Rapoport]] and biochemist [[Samuel Mitja Rapoport]], and brother of biochemist [[Tom Rapoport]].
